source: Anthropic's published API list prices: the model table cached in the claude-api skill on 2026-10-06, and its prompt-caching notes (cache reads 0.1x the input price, 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5; cache writes 1.25x for the 5-minute TTL and 2x for the 1-hour TTL). Per million tokens, in US dollars. Thinking tokens are part of output_tokens, so they are priced as output.

calibration.what: Claude Code writes its own running cost into a transcript (a cost-state record). For claude-sonnet-5-5 the same tokens at these prices reproduce its recorded cost exactly ($17.7706 for 6,824 input, 228,619 output, 45,036,636 cache-read and 1,615,857 one-hour cache-write tokens). Counting the transcript's own requests up to the same output-token total gave a cost 2.5% to 9.0% below Claude Code's own figure at five snapshots of one long session: Claude Code also counts calls the transcript does not record.
